description: Welcome to Coding Buddies! We are a collaborative team joining the 2026 NASA Space Apps Challenge in Colombo, tackling the "Field Shift: Adapting Farms with NASA Data" challenge. Our goal is to build a practical, data-driven tool that helps farmers adapt to shifting weather patterns using NASA Earth observation archives.
summary:
FieldDrift is an innovative decision-support platform designed to help farmers adapt to changing climates by translating complex NASA Earth observations and local soil characteristics into actionable, farmer-friendly insights.

By analyzing critical edaphic parameters such as soil composition (including phosphorus levels) alongside real-time and historical climatic data, the tool enables growers to evaluate which crops are genuinely suitable for harvest and optimal rotation in their specific fields. Furthermore, FieldDrift leverages satellite remote-sensing data to continuously monitor environmental stresses, tracking whether crops have been subjected to damaging weather events like floods.

Ultimately, the platform bridges the gap between advanced spaceborne data and practical agronomy. It empowers agricultural communities to make data-driven decisions, mitigate environmental risks, and select the best-suited crops to maximize resilience and long-term farm profitability.
details:
Project Details

FieldDrift is an adaptive agricultural decision-support platform that translates complex NASA Earth observations and local soil profiles into actionable farming insights. Built using Python, geospatial APIs, and machine learning frameworks alongside NASA satellite datasets (such as SMAP, GPM, and MODIS), the system evaluates field-level soil characteristics—like phosphorus and nutrient levels—alongside real-time weather and shifting climatic patterns to determine optimal crop suitability and harvest timing. Additionally, it utilizes satellite remote sensing to actively detect and assess flood exposure on active farmland.

What makes FieldDrift uniquely creative is how it bridges advanced spaceborne telemetry with practical, accessible agronomy, turning raw environmental data into clear, localized crop recommendations. When designing the solution, our team prioritized data accessibility for non-technical users, dynamic climate adaptability, and real-world regional farming constraints. By empowering farmers to anticipate weather risks, mitigate flood losses, and pivot toward climate-resilient crops, FieldDrift aims to reduce agricultural waste, boost yield profitability, and strengthen long-term food security for farming communities facing unpredictable climate shifts.
